answers.core: It does open the window for new workflows and editing, if the decal node comes by default, I would see no reason why multimasking of decal-like shaders for meshes would be something unwanted.
answers.workaround: Editing godot source code allows quite easily to skip opacity masking for normal and orm textures in decal nodes by skipping the mix functions in scene_forward.glsl around line 2120, but further features will require more work.

title: Add mesh decals and multi-opacity decals
